headline: Fuel in Lebanon: Why Brent Is Not Enough
summary: Fuel prices in Lebanon depend on refined product quotations, transport and insurance costs, not on Brent crude alone, according to an analysis by Georges Brax.
why: Brent is the global benchmark for crude oil, but refined product prices and freight costs determine what consumers pay at the pump.
